acceptance: Disposable-repository tests: a stale integration head is refused; a merge whose tree differs from the member's is refused; an overlap triggers the earlier member's rerun and records it; a crash after merge and before prepare is reported by batch-status and a repeated batch-land does not merge twice; a deleted ledger is rebuilt from tracker and Git.
batch-land outside a role=integration worktree refuses.
verify passes after origin/develop moves and after a recorded develop merge, and fails on an unrecorded first-parent commit.
Registered member order is preserved in all output.

batch-advance records a fix with its changed files and reruns the recorded verification commands of every earlier member whose files the fix touches; a develop merge is recorded as develop-merge and triggers no member rerun.

batch-land refuses when the local review cache holds no result for the member's patch digest, base and head tree, even if the member's config says clear; a not-reviewed result for an exempt-only member is accepted.
A silent-revert fixture prints the hunk warning and still lands.
batch-land warns when a landing moves the final brief out of inline mode and refuses one that would make the file list exceed brief_max_bytes.
batch-evidence refuses while any required rerun is missing or older than the current integration head, and otherwise produces evidence that todo-db finish accepts.
context: Decision gate: start only after batch-member-side-tooling-20261101 is done. The hunk warning is advisory; the overlap rerun is the guard. Write preflight ownership is a guardrail, not a lock (no session id skips it; BENCHBOX_WORKTREE_TAKEOVER=1 bypasses it, agent_write_preflight.sh:200-203); the unchanged-head check is what serialises landings. Guardrails: deliver as an ordinary serial PR to develop (AGENTS.md: feature delivery cannot deliver the changes that make it possible); write only from a linked worktree made with make worktree-create and checked with make agent-write-preflight, never the primary clone; stage explicit paths, never git add -A; no explanatory comments or docstrings (COMMENT-POLICY-001, make comment-policy-check); heavy test runs only through lock-taking entry points, never BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK; never weaken hold labels, the unresolved-thread refusal, oracle-gate, duration or suite gates; add a changelog.d fragment (CHANGELOG_INTERNAL when nothing is user-visible); durable artifacts carry no session or phase labels; cited line numbers are leads, so re-read the code before editing; tests prove behaviour, never wiring or wording. The backup push after each landing keeps the integration branch recoverable for owner recovery from another checkout; ci.yml triggers only on pull_request (.github/workflows/ci.yml:10-13), so check that no other workflow runs on pushes to feat/* branches before relying on it.
description: Add the leader side in scripts/batch_integration.py and make/batch.mk. batch-land MEMBER=<id> runs only in the role=integration worktree: it refuses if the integration head moved since the member synced; recomputes clean tree, member head, containment of the integration head and scope; reads the member's oracle result from the local review cache instead of trusting the member's config; merges with --no-ff; refuses unless the merged tree equals the member's tree; prints a non-blocking hunk-presence warning (git diff -U0, then git apply -R --check --unidiff-zero; it misses reverted deletions and reverted generic lines); when the member changed files an earlier member changed, reruns that earlier member's recorded verification commands on the landed head and records the result; writes the ledger under .todo-batch/<batch>/; pushes the integration branch as a backup; and prints the prepare payload. batch-advance records a leader fix commit or a develop merge for the todo-db advance operation. batch-status reconciles the ledger with the tracker's batch record and Git, rebuilds a missing ledger, and after an interruption between merge and prepare names the next step without merging again. Fix verify to check the integration branch's first-parent history and accept recorded develop merges, instead of failing whenever origin/develop moves (batch_integration.py:130-132); keep the registered member order (:95 sorts it); stop treating the committer-identity check (:135-141) as enforcement. batch-advance also reruns the recorded verification commands of every earlier member whose files a fix touches. batch-status reports the combined change's inline diff size and file-list size against brief_max_bytes, and batch-land refuses a landing that would make the file list exceed the cap, because the hosted reviewers would then be skipped. batch-evidence builds the final-tree evidence that todo-db finish and pr_arm read: per-member current acceptance including overlap and fix-advance reruns, recorded advances and the bound final PR.
